[b]Internal Memo, Confidential: December 6, 2026 (Leaked to the internationale)[/b]

Mr. Drømm,

The successful completion of the procedures on Federalisation is widely celebrated in the city-confederation. The Communist Party of North Thýven is confident in the abilities of the state to reorganize under this new federal framework.

However, the CPNT is deeply concerned with a recent memo which has been circulating (as you and I discussed) around the various smaller communist and communalist groups in Thýven. The contents of this memo you are familiar with, so I need not review them here.

Nevertheless the CPNT is concerned primarily with the ability of Thýven to transition safely into a communist state under the current conditions. 

Firstly, the lines of Citharism are unclear in their ability to dwell securely within Thrømm society and tradition without a total erasure of the cultural norms of this state. Thus in line with traditional Thrømmic values on community, the centralised vanguard is impossible, but instead must comprise of a network of communes and workers councils, with any vanguard party acting merely as a guide to the communist state.

Secondly, Thýven remains a highly religious state, any attempt to tear down the church will result in the failure of the communist experiment. We must therefore ensure that the renaissance socialist ideals of Montfleur and Sanguivallis are adopted instead of the mainline ideals of the socialist thought on religion overall. The church must remain a guiding arm to the worker, because the soul is the root of the worker.

Thirdly, under the socialist system the call for revolutionary unity is hard to create in Thýven thusfar without years of seeding, reform, and re-education. Thus local autonomy must be maintained, with the councils interacting and coordinating with eachother under a centralised model (the central government) to ensure a unified purpose while maintaining Thývens fierce communal identity.

It is thus under these initial observations that the CPNT advises that we maintain a cordial relationship with the international, while seeking to maintain our own unique identity. Communism is achievable if done right.

Sincerely,
Erjk Malben
Chairman of the CPNT & Aid to Piter Drømm

[nation]Qianxun[/nation]
